skills.name: tdd
skills.role_workflow_authority: Active Octo/Symphony role workflow owns TDD activation policy, routing, handoff evidence, and submodule delivery.
skills.execution_contract: Use as the primary red-green-refactor development loop whenever the active role workflow requires TDD.

skills.name: frontend-design
use_when: issue-scoped UI or frontend work changes web components, pages, dashboards, applications, or styling
do_not_use_when: work is fully constrained by an existing design-system decision

octo_authority_boundaries: Linear repository metadata remains the repository source of truth
work must stay on the issue branch
role workflow state transitions remain authoritative
PR ownership and issue linkage remain authoritative
legacy Codex Workpad context when present and the immutable Symphony Handoff trail remain authoritative
validation requirements from the issue, specs, ADRs, workpad, and handoff remain authoritative
Human Escalation routing remains authoritative when required source artifacts are missing, unreadable, or conflicting
